name: Casa Emtia Petrol Kimyevi ve Turevleri San. Tic. A.S.
summary: Casa Emtia Petrol Kimyevi ve Turevleri San. Tic. A.S. produces fish flour and fish oil in Turkey. It also engages in the buying and selling of real estate properties. Casa Emtia Petrol Kimyevi ve Turevleri San. Tic. A.S. was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Istanbul, Turkey.
